feed.title: HeatWatch
feed.subtitle: Where heat is breaking records, who it is reaching, what the rules are about to require, and what can be done about it.

entry.title: England's Severn Trent reservoirs sit far below last year's level
entry.summary: Severn Trent's own reservoirs held 49.8 percent of capacity in late October, against 82.2 percent on the same date last year. — Sources: Severn Trent Water reservoir levels / UK Environment Agency drought status, reported late October 2026

entry.title: Singapore's haze eased today, but the west region remains unhealthy
entry.summary: Singapore's four eastern, northern, southern and central regions moved back into the moderate air-quality band this afternoon, reading between 72 and 90. — Sources: National Environment Agency, real-time PSI data, direct fetch, 22 October 2026

entry.title: Indonesia's fire-hotspot count jumped to its highest reading in over a week
entry.summary: Indonesia's hotspot count rose to 20,392 on 19 October, up from 17,706 the day before, reversing a dip reported earlier in the month. No figure has been found for 20, 21 or 22 October. — Sources: Ministry of Forestry/BMKG via Katadata, 19 October 2026
